mandatoryFindings.title: Response body collection is unbounded before length rejection
mandatoryFindings.evidence: ofByteArray collects the full body;262144-byte check runs only after synchronous send returns.
mandatoryFindings.requiredCorrection: Enforce the262144-byte limit while consuming the observer response, fail closed/cancel on oversize, retain no raw body and preserve original oracle/hooks. Test actual Java boundary in later authorized validation; Python reference cannot prove it.

mandatoryFindings.title: Request timeout does not bound full observation and owned client lifetime
mandatoryFindings.evidence: Pinned OpenJDK21 response timer is cancelled before readBodyAsync. Candidate has no body deadline and discards its client without finally cancellation/termination accounting; a stalled body can block original assertion.
mandatoryFindings.requiredCorrection: Use an observer-local total15s deadline covering request/body and finite failure/cleanup handling, retain/cancel/account observer-owned operations in all exits, preserve actual unresolved status as HOLD and execute unchanged business oracle/hooks. Do not assume cancel is instant or add unbounded close, global fixture change, retry or process signal.

mandatoryFindings.title: One send/CAS does not establish one transport attempt
mandatoryFindings.evidence: GET and unprocessed/connection failures can enter cited implementation retries within one application send. Synthetic send can hide two transport events and still pass projection.
mandatoryFindings.requiredCorrection: Provide exact observer-local enforcement/evidence of adopted one-read/no-retry contract, or obtain explicit owning design qualification before changing that meaning. No implicit waiver or global ordinary-fixture retry property change; preserve cap1 and unknown/failure semantics.

mandatoryFindings.title: Secure traversal is not bound to root-approved output directory identity
mandatoryFindings.evidence: Writer retains no-follow directory handles and exclusively creates0600 file, but never checks opened directory expected identity, owner,0700 mode or named continuity. A substituted ordinary directory passes all explicit writer checks.
mandatoryFindings.requiredCorrection: Bind the approved runtime output directory/necessary ancestors to actual root-owned identity metadata, verify opened identity/owner/mode and relevant named continuity through write using retained handles; preserve nofollow/CREATE_NEW/0600 and closed-only export. Reject mismatch with honest unavailable/HOLD evidence. No generic same-UID security expansion.
